rubrics.intent_basis: R1 discovery owner removed; depth caller publication/callee low initialization.
rubrics.baseline_defect: Time, visit order, lowlink and active vertices are separately owned and partially initialized across roots and recursive calls.
rubrics.criterion: Own discovery state and initialization coherently across root/child discovery and SCC/BCC use.
rubrics.acceptance: Preserve single time increment, visit order, initial low value, stack order, SCC active-component check and component numbering. Initialization may remain at caller or callee if its complete contract is owned; no fixed visit-method requirement. Existing Graph/FlowGraph/iterator ownership, restored recursion and encapsulated parallel storage are valid; no mandatory record per edge, per vertex or per frame. Equivalent functions, policy data, composition or a redesigned flow qualify; no prescribed helper, class, file, return object or one-component-per-item design is required. One coherent redesign may satisfy multiple independent items.
insufficient_repairs: A wrapper that still requires consumers to independently coordinate the same data association is insufficient.
